scope: Startup backend refresh, manual cloud sync card, explicit AI configuration states

automated_tests.deduplication: Latest final result by full suite path and test name; excludes synthetic loading entries, setUpAll/tearDownAll lifecycle hooks, and repeated successful retests.
commands: flutter test --no-pub --reporter json <explicit card test file>
covered_behaviors: First-frame startup wiring and configuration-before-sync ordering
Guest public configuration only; no protected personal sync requests
30-second successful configuration cache and shared in-flight requests
Manual force and upgrade of an in-flight background refresh
Auto-sync preference, administrator backup gate and feature gate
Old account/server responses and disposal cannot start stale sync
Card clicks, busy state, duplicate requests, failure and recovery
Actual StatisticsScreen entry automatically loads configuration
AI report archives, preserved history, clipboard and narrow large-text layout
Account/profile isolation, preference survival, typography and existing UI guards
automated_tests.early_failures: Initial missing legacy interfaces, test-fixture errors and formatting issues were corrected. Their logs remain in session scratch; final counts use the successful corrected results.

web_build.command: FLUTTER_BIN=<pinned Flutter 3.44.1>/bin/flutter python3 scripts/flutter_with_config.py build web --release --base-href=/
web_build.additional_settings_boundary: The two unchanged root settings were verified against the baseline git blobs separately; they are not included in the 396 before/after count.
